modern: When you get up from sleep reluctantly, remember that it is in keeping with your constitution and with human nature to perform social acts, but sleeping is something we share even with irrational animals. And what is according to each individual’s nature is also more particularly its own, and more suited to its nature, and indeed also more pleasant.
original: When thou risest from sleep with reluctance, remember that it is according to thy constitution and according to human nature to perform social acts, but sleeping is common also to irrational animals. But that which is according to each individual’s nature is also more peculiarly its own, and more suitable to its nature, and indeed also more agreeable.
